limitations: Host semantic object types erased in packaged native ABI remain protocol/id boundaries; no YouTube runtime is executed.
Canonical feature-policy calls retain local preference policy; historical account policy is an integration audit owned by parent.
Packaged anti-debug SVC side effects and constant-decryption/opaque-dispatch machinery are omitted. Functional branch decisions and callbacks are preserved.
Helper associated-object identity uses a private unique address instead of packaged getter IMP; retention and property metadata match.
No constructors: parent supplies original registration order and cross-module hook chaining.
